en: Dependent on a determined wholesome state, a non-determined, non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on an undetermined wholesome state, a non-determined, non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. [Under] root [condition], there are two; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance [condition], there are two.
Dependent on a determined unwholesome state, a non-determined, non-unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate unwholesome state, there arises a state that is neither indeterminate nor unwholesome by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
There are two [answers] for root; ... pe ... two for non-disappearance (*avigata*). (In the indeterminate root, there are two conditions.)
